cost_definition: one cost unit per acquired material row; a selected chemical-system group reveals all rows in that group

strategy_contracts.fixed_catalog: Non-adaptive baseline: acquire remaining chemical-system groups in stable lexical order.
strategy_contracts.random: Non-adaptive baseline: acquire groups in a deterministic seeded hash order.
strategy_contracts.diversity: Target-blind human-designed baseline: repeatedly choose the group whose planner-visible descriptor centroid is farthest from currently labelled group centroids after seed-fitted scaling.
strategy_contracts.uncertainty: Adaptive agent baseline: fit fixed Ridge and histogram-gradient-boosting models on currently labelled evidence and choose the group with highest mean absolute model disagreement; fall back to diversity when fitting is not viable.

scientific_boundary: Acquisition strategy may use only seed labels and planner-visible acquisition features before a group is selected.
Oracle acquisition labels may be read only after the selected group is fixed for that step.
Locked-test rows and targets may not be read by sequence execution.
The fixed primary evaluation model is predeclared and may not be changed after locked-test metrics are observed.
Improved locked-test metrics would support research-efficiency evidence only for this retrospective Materials Project benchmark, not experimental synthesizability, causality, or production screening.
